jobs.description: About Encrypted Computation News & Media Resource Hub Careers Close Mobile Menu About Encrypted Computation News & Media Resource Hub Careers Menu Encrypted Computation Encrypted Computation Solutions Our ASICs and processors enable high-performance encrypted computation at scale. Built on decades of chip design expertise and advanced semiconductor process nodes, our architecture supports AI, cloud, and other data-sensitive applications. Encrypted Computation Processor 3PU™ is a Fully Homomorphic Encryption (FHE) processor designed to enable practical, scalable encrypted computation for AI and cloud workloads. Purpose-built for the unique demands of FHE, the 3PU™ accelerates encrypted computation while reducing the performance barriers that have historically limited adoption. Learn more Learn more Fully Homomorphic Encryption (FHE) Fully Homomorphic Encryption (FHE) is a breakthrough cryptographic technology that enables computation on encrypted data while keeping information protected throughout processing. As the foundation of privacy-preserving AI and cloud computing, FHE powers a new generation of secure applications. The 3PU™ is purpose-built to accelerate FHE workloads at scale. Learn More About Encrypted Computation Processor Learn More About Encrypted Computation Processor  Sales Inquiries EL3CTRUM ASIC Our EL3CTRUM ASIC is the most efficient hashing ASIC on the market, optimized for high-performance, high efficiency, and low-power. EL3CTRUM delivers optimal payback time. EL3CTRUM HASHBOARD The EL3CTRUM Hashboard provides the power and flexibility to create your own hashing system. Built with our EL3CTRUM ASICs, it also features SPI and 1 2 C interfaces, a single power connector, aluminum extrusion heatsinks and backplate, and onboard measurement with alerts for temperature and power. EL3CTRUM SYSTEM Powered by our exclusive ASICs, the EL3CTRUM Bitcoin Hashing System has proprietary design and plug-and-play functionality. Highly responsive, reliable, and easy to use the system gives you ultimate control of your mining operations and significantly quicker payback time.
